instructions: This is the Redux Toolkit monorepo. packages/toolkit is the published @reduxjs/toolkit library; everything it exports, including types, is public API used by many apps.
Report breaking changes to exported runtime behavior or types, and new cost on code paths most apps do not use.

RTK Query (packages/toolkit/src/query) bugs usually involve cache entry lifecycle (subscriptions, keepUnusedDataFor, removal), tag invalidation, request ordering and stale responses, and React hook timing (render vs. effect, StrictMode double effects, selector stability).
Already covered, do not report: formatting (oxfmt), lint rules (oxlint), and type errors (tsc and type tests run in CI).
Review environment: no network access. Do not try to install packages or fetch URLs.
